milestone.title: raul Autopilot lane: retire the legacy Watch model — migrate live readers to app.autopilot, rename render/watch.rs, delete tui::watch

intent.outcome: After M229's mp-side removal, the raul TUI exposes a single Autopilot lane with no duplicate Watch state, no Watch-prefixed Action variants, and no tui::watch module; users who press the same keymap as today reach the same outcome.

problem.description: The Autopilot lane still leans on the pre-autopilot Watch model. render/watch.rs is the LIVE Autopilot lane renderer (lane_lists.rs:43 dispatches Lane::Autopilot to render_watch_lane) and reads app.watch.{selected,picker_index,status,log_tail} plus watch::render_lifecycle_graph / render_compact_queue; view_state.rs:1330 and the picker fall back to app.watch.candidates when app.autopilot.picker is empty; runner_helpers.rs:180-193 refreshes app.watch on every load; autopilot.rs:53 imports watch::DRIVABLE_LIFECYCLES (a re-export of mp_model::WATCH_DRIVABLE_LIFECYCLES). Meanwhile the rest is dead: every tui/watch.rs runner call targets `mp watch-control`, which no longer exists (status restore always returns None), and no keybind dispatches the Action::Watch* variants (action.rs:241-266, handlers ~849-880). Deleting the files outright would break the lane; the live readers must move to AutopilotLaneState first (it already owns picker.candidates/selected/cursor and polled health).

in_scope: Move render_lifecycle_graph (+ LIFECYCLE_NODES) and render_compact_queue into crates/raul/src/tui/autopilot.rs, reading app.autopilot.picker.selected; the lifecycle graph gets no active node (identical to today's runtime, where watch status is always None).

Replace the DRIVABLE_LIFECYCLES import with mp_model::WATCH_DRIVABLE_LIFECYCLES; drop the app.watch.candidates fallbacks (render picker, view_state.rs:1330) and the runner_helpers refresh_candidates / restore_latest_status calls.
Rename crates/raul/src/tui/render/watch.rs → render/autopilot_lane.rs and render_watch_lane → render_autopilot_lane.
Delete crates/raul/src/tui/watch.rs, App::watch + Watch::empty(), and the Action::Watch* variants and handlers (incl. the watch_before change-detection at action.rs:378/1119).

Migrate or delete raul tests that touch the Watch model: tui_state, tui_render, m215_f01_picker_production_path, autopilot_status_graph, tui_status_parity (keep every assertion that is about the Autopilot lane; drop legacy-fallback-only cases).
Sweep residual Watch-lane comments; prune stale-watch allowlist entries in scripts/check-consumer-surface.sh that no longer match a line.
CHANGELOG entry: internal raul cleanup, no user-visible change.
out_of_scope: Changing the Autopilot lane layout or keybinds — that is M241 (which builds on render/autopilot_lane.rs).
Renaming mp_model::WATCH_DRIVABLE_LIFECYCLES or any mp autopilot CLI / state shape.
Keybind config migration: Watch* actions were never user-bindable.
Removing historical changelog entries or archived milestone files.

design_decisions.choice: Migrate the three live readers (lane renderer, picker fallback, runner_helpers refresh) onto app.autopilot and rename render/watch.rs to render/autopilot_lane.rs before deleting tui::watch
design_decisions.rationale: render/watch.rs is the live Autopilot lane renderer; deleting first would break the lane. The watch-status path calls the removed mp watch-control verb and already yields None at runtime, so the migration is behavior-preserving.
